items.title: Pfizer vs. Johnson & Johnson: Which Pharma Giant Is Better Prepared for Its Patent Cliff?
items.summary: Patent expirations are forcing Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) and Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) to prove that their newer medicines can replace some of their most successful franchises. Pfizer is simultaneously managing declining COVID-19 revenue and approaching losses of exclusivity, while Johnson & Johnson is already contending with the rapid erosion of Stelara. items.title: Pfizer’s Turnaround is Gaining Traction, but Can New Products Offset its Patent Cliff?
items.summary: Pfizer Inc. (NYSE:PFE) is beginning to show signs of steadier growth following the sharp decline in its pandemic-related business. The pharmaceutical giant reported a 1% year-over-year operational increase in fiscal Q2 2026 revenue to $15.0 billion, while revenue excluding Comirnaty and Paxlovid grew 5% operationally. Management also raised the midpoint of its full-year revenue guidance. […]
